name: por_delay
description: Boot-delay verification: TESTPOR's READY pin holds at 0V until 100µs, then asserts 3.3V. Layer-5c voltage_after_delay topology.

expected.rationale: Before delay: pin holds at before_v=0V.
Halfway through the boot window, still asserting 0V.
Well past delay (100µs), pin has transitioned to after_v=3.3V.
